blocking_focus: Complete the candidate-bound Tester MCP state matrix.

preservation_constraints.requirement: Keep frozen technical baseline `clean_boot` passing. Do not treat this as a mandate to preserve the same visible asset, map, HUD family, or material choice if a higher-quality replacement is available and the PRD still fits.

task_specification.objective: Restore authoritative mouse look, then make one uninterrupted ordinary-input mission run reach Alpha and continue through the preserved A/B/C 3/5/10 enemy progression; additionally restore natural player movement Foley through the single retained owner without replacing preserved map or viewmodel packages.

diagnosis.root_cause: The hard playability blocker is input routing, not world transforms: gameplay reports captured mouse state, but ordinary mouse motion produces no verified yaw or pitch change, so the existing spawn-to-Alpha route and 3/5/10 encounter chain cannot be exercised reliably. The route findings are consequently dominated by interrupted runs rather than proof that the preserved authored map is disconnected. Separately, player Foley still lacks verified listener output: the retained WalkAudio/RunAudio ownership path has been repeatedly adapted, but current evidence does not prove natural contact-aligned steps or removal of the reported buzz. Highlight clipping remains an independent soft daylight regression and must stay visible in the patrol rather than prompting another speculative exposure pass.

stop_conditions: Do not reposition, duplicate, extract, or edit authored children of the preserved StandoffArena instance; route repair must remain in product-owned input, navigation, anchor, encounter, or instrumentation adapters.

If captured mouse motion still produces zero yaw or pitch after repairing one authoritative input path, stop route or AI tuning and retain the input blocker with the exact rejected event/lifecycle state.

Reject an enemy spawn when its full capsule lacks floor/navigation support or intersects authored geometry; do not hide occupancy failures by teleporting the actor or allowing outward shots through walls.

Do not replace or surgically modify the preserved coupled viewmodel component. Keep WalkAudio and RunAudio as the sole player-Foley owner unless an atomic, evidence-backed replacement is explicitly justified.
If mixed-output capture or audition remains unavailable, report insufficient audio evidence and keep the Foley issue open; do not promote new gain, cadence, or sample changes as accepted.
Stop and repair any candidate-script parse, boot, runtime callback, freed-object, collision, navigation, audio, or input error before claiming either task complete.

strategy.rationale: Use a materially different root-cause order from repeated transform tuning: first consolidate captured mouse motion into one player-owned lifecycle-safe look path, then qualify the already-preserved native route and encounter transaction under ordinary input. Treat Foley as a separate bounded adapter/mix repair based on the last known-good retained owner, while carrying daylight clipping as a matched-view regression patrol.

code: Run the candidate import, script parse, and clean-boot checks; require zero parser, resource-load, input, navigation, collision, audio, and late callback errors.

Inspect input ownership statically: hidden shell Controls ignore gameplay motion, only the intended player path mutates yaw/pitch, and pause/settings transitions synchronize global and internal capture state.

Inspect Foley ownership and emitter construction: one player owner, no runtime-generated movement placeholder, no long-stream per-contact restart, valid decoded-source provenance, and explicit bus-stage reporting.
Confirm preserved StandoffArena authored-child transforms, native materials, additive collision/navigation wrapper, viewmodel bindings, Barlow HUD typography, and F6/R mappings remain unchanged.
runtime: Tester recaptures separate horizontal and vertical mouse-look sequences after normal deployment, pause/resume, settings return, F6, checkpoint restore, and Replay, pairing inputs with advancing yaw/pitch state.

Tester performs one retained uninterrupted title-to-Alpha-to-Bravo-to-Charlie run, binding legal Alpha timing, capture commits, route unlocks, stable 3/5/10 IDs, AI states, occupancy, shot occlusion, and lifecycle state.

Tester captures idle, walk, sprint, crouch, and landing mixed output plus active-stream inventories, source/playback positions, contact receipts, and listener gain; natural audibility and buzz absence require listening evidence.

Run the fixed FPS patrol for movement, R/F6 separation, AUTO release/recoil return, reticle-ballistic agreement, lifecycle reset, enemy occupancy/animation, environment layers, and late runtime logs without restarting Godot.
visual: Capture shipped first-person views at deployment, the critical spawn-to-Alpha route, legal Alpha overlap, Bravo, and Charlie, showing readable routes and distributed enemies rather than diagnostic-only cameras.

Capture adjacent combat frames for representative A/B/C actors showing locomotion, aim telegraph, fire, reload, hurt, and death while bodies remain upright, grounded, separated, weapon-bound, and clear of authored walls.

Retain matched daylight views of directly lit plaster, concrete, and corrugated surfaces and report sky, shadows, SSAO, both cloud layers, sun flare, and exposure separately; keep highlight clipping open if texture detail is still lost.

Compare target-resolution gameplay composition with the bound visual reference for unobstructed reticle, objective markers, minimap, combat feed, ammo, health, and countdown while preserving the transparent route-guidance lane.

done_when: Separate horizontal and vertical captured-mouse sequences change player yaw and camera pitch in authoritative gameplay, with nonzero before/after receipts after deployment, pause/resume, and F6 reset.

A fresh title-to-deployment run reaches the first legal Alpha overlap in 30–45 seconds from first ordinary movement without F6, checkpoint restore, death, terminal interruption, or generation-mismatched route receipts.
The same uninterrupted run can secure Alpha and Bravo and enter Charlie while preserving stable 3/5/10 roster identities, activation order, route slots, deaths, ammunition, and checkpoint state.

Active enemies remain capsule-clear, grounded, spatially separated, and distributed across route, cover, angle, and elevation roles; reciprocal static-world occlusion blocks invalid enemy and player shots.

Adjacent runtime samples bind perception, search, movement, cover/flank, aim telegraph, authorized fire, finite-magazine reload, hurt, death, and cleanup to authoritative state for representative actors in A, B, and C.
Mouse look, walk/strafe, sprint, ADS, fire, R reload, pause/resume, and F6 reset remain responsive without a Godot process restart or late runtime errors.
tasks.instructions: Repair the fresh mouse-look blocker at the product input boundary: trace shell visibility/focus, viewport handling, Input.mouse_mode, the player's internal capture flag, and InputEventMouseMotion delivery, then establish one authoritative player-owned look intake that cannot be swallowed by hidden full-viewport Controls and survives deployment, pause/resume, settings return, checkpoint restore, Replay, and F6. Preserve R for reload. Once look is functional, qualify and, only where needed, repair the existing native spawn-to-Alpha transaction and encounter activation/pacing so ordinary play can reach legal Alpha overlap and continue through A/B/C without death or terminal interruption masking the 3/5/10 matrix. Do not repeat authored-map transform tuning. Preserve stable enemy IDs and the current animation/AI component sources; repair product adapters, activation authority, attack telegraph, survivable route pressure, occupancy rejection, lifecycle retention, and bounded state instrumentation. Enemy damage must be authorized only from a capsule-clear muzzle with reciprocal line of sight, while navigation velocity, reservations, and collision-sized spacing drive visible autonomous behavior.
tasks.title: Restore mouse-look authority and qualify uninterrupted A/B/C combat progression

done_when: Exactly one retained player-Foley owner drives WalkAudio and RunAudio; mission feedback and other observers create no second player footstep playback path.

Idle mixed output contains no reported buzz, hum, synthesized movement cue, or cadence-restarted long recording, while ordinary walk, sprint, crouch, and landing produce natural contact-aligned decoded footsteps.
Each accepted contact receipt identifies locomotion, surface, source variant, playback owner, node gain, pitch, Foley and Master bus stages, competing active streams, and effective listener gain.
Walk, sprint, crouch, and landing remain distinguishable in rhythm and loudness, restart cleanly across pause, F6, checkpoint restore, and Replay, and do not overlap indefinitely or clip.
The repair preserves event authority, licensed source provenance, deterministic variation, and current viewmodel bindings without speculative source-package replacement or late audio-node leaks.
tasks.instructions: Bound this cross-surface task to the active natural-walking Foley regression. Before changing samples, gains, or cadence, compare the current runtime owner and product adapter with the last user-accepted Loop 10–19 player-footstep path. Restore that known-good retained component owner and adapter/mix behavior first. Keep WalkAudio and RunAudio as the sole player-Foley playback nodes; side channels may observe contact events and report mix state but must not play duplicate player steps. Remove or mute only concurrently audible placeholder oscillator/noise streams proven during reproduction, while preserving intentional production procedural audio. Use licensed decoded, contact-aligned sources already bound to the product when suitable; never restart a multi-second recording per contact. Expose bounded source duration, playback position, cadence, gain/pitch, Foley/Master stages, active competing emitters, and effective listener gain so host mixed-output recapture can determine audibility and buzz absence.
